name: Coordinator agent onboarding text and no-project next action
aliases: create a child task over HTTP
summary: The owner-visible agent record carries coordinates [{project, effective}]: the agent's coordinator grants in projects its owner is a member of, computed live, shown only to the agent's owner or a superuser signed in as a person (never to another member or to any credential, the agent's own included). web/js/agentSetup.js writes the coordinator's .orchestra/AGENT.md when one grant has effect. Its first step checks GET /v1/projects and GET /v1/service/certificate with curl -K and the setup-generated .crt, compares SHA-256, confirms the project and coordinator section, and reports the result without disclosing the secret file. The remaining guide preserves the coordinator run order, never-claim rule, task and child creation routes, review/assign/comment/integration-check routes, worker and other-machine guidance, questions, data-not-instructions rule, and adds approve-not-recommend and Requirement-record guidance. For an agent with no visible project and no other action, /v1/agents/me/next returns a generic no-project next_action without exposing project identities; next_actions and attention are unchanged. Other agents keep the worker AGENT.md.
